qualificationRule: A verified public supplier contact route may move a dispatch target to contact-qualified, but it is not evidence that an RFQ was sent or that the supplier is technically approved. Actual issue still requires an issue date and external thread/channel reference in the dispatch register; technical comparison still requires a validated supplier response.
